title: StrengthUnified
description: StrengthUnified is a comprehensive strength-based SMP plugin that adds a progressive strength system to your Minecraft server. Players can increase their strength through crafting special items and PvP combat.
body:
StrengthUnified is a comprehensive strength-based SMP plugin created by arsec4real that adds a progressive strength system to your Minecraft server. Players can increase their strength through crafting special items and PvP combat, with the ability to go into negative values for high-risk gameplay.

Supported Versions: Minecraft 1.21.4 - 1.21.11 Latest Version: 1.0

Features
Core Features

Strength System → Players have a strength value ranging from -5 to 5 (configurable)

Custom Items → Craftable Strength Enhancers and Reroll Books

PvP Integration → Gain strength from kills, lose strength from deaths

Item Durability → Each item has limited uses (configurable)

Negative Strength → Players can fall into negative values, dealing reduced damage

Visual Indicators → Action bar messages showing damage bonus/penalty

**Combat Features** 

Kill Gains: +1 strength per kill (configurable)

**Death Penalties**

-1 strength per death (configurable)

Kill Cooldown: 5-minute cooldown per player pair to prevent farming

Max Strength Overflow    : Drops strength tokens when at max

Milestone Broadcasts     : Announces when players reach significant strength levels

Visual Effects           : Lightning strikes on kills, particle effects on deaths


**Custom Items Strength Enhancer (Nautilus Shell)**

Purpose: Increases player strength by 1 level

Uses: 5 uses per item (configurable)

Craftable: Yes (see recipe below)

Lore: Shows current strength and remaining uses


Reroll Book 

Purpose: Randomizes weapon enchantments

Uses: 5 uses per item (configurable)

Craftable: Yes (see recipe below)


**Enchantments**

→ Sharpness, Smite, Bane of Arthropods, Fire Aspect, Knockback

Installation : Java 21 or higher

Paper/Spigot server 1.21.4 - 1.21.11


**LuckPerms Setup**

Default players

/lp group <group_name> permission set strengthunified.default true 

/lp group <group_name> permission set strengthunified.use true 

/lp group <group_name> permission set strengthunified.command.strength true


Moderators or Admins

/lp group <group_name> permission set strengthunified.moderator true 

/lp group <group_name> permission set strengthunified.command.strengthunified true 

/lp group <group_name> permission set strengthunified.command.strengthunified.give true 

/lp group <group_name> permission set strengthunified.command.strengthunified.status true


Owner

/lp group admin permission set strengthunified.admin true 

/lp group admin permission set strengthunified.* true   (* Gives Full command access)
